description: We are SIGMA, a team passionate about space exploration, technology and innovation. Our project, LUNA – Lunar Survival Simulator, is a low-poly 3D game where players manage oxygen, water and energy while surviving on the Moon. We welcome creative thinkers, programmers, 3D designers and space enthusiasts who enjoy teamwork, problem-solving and learning new skills. Together, we aim to turn an exciting idea into a playable experience!
summary:
**LUNA: Lunar Base Survival**

LUNA is a 3D third-person lunar survival game developed for the NASA Challenge. The game follows an astronaut stranded on the Moon after an unexpected mission failure. Players must explore the lunar surface, discover abandoned equipment, collect essential resources, restore power to the lunar base, and re-establish communication with Earth. Their ultimate objective is to activate an emergency rescue beacon and complete the mission.

Built using Godot 4, LUNA aims to combine engaging survival gameplay with an educational experience inspired by real lunar exploration. Through its interactive environment and mission-based objectives, the game encourages players to explore the challenges astronauts may face during lunar missions and understand the importance of technology, resource management, and problem-solving in space exploration.
details:
Project Details – LUNA: Lunar Base Survival

LUNA is a 3D third-person lunar survival game based on an original idea developed by our team. The game follows an astronaut stranded on the Moon after an unexpected mission failure. Players explore the lunar surface, discover abandoned equipment, collect essential resources, restore power to the lunar base, reconnect with Earth and activate an emergency rescue beacon to complete the mission.

The project aims to make lunar exploration more engaging and educational by allowing players to experience the challenges of surviving on the Moon. It encourages problem-solving, exploration, critical thinking and awareness of future space missions.

The original concept and storyline were created by our team, while AstraCode was used as an AI-assisted development tool. Godot 4, GDScript and Visual Studio Code were used in the development process.

Our creativity lies in combining space exploration, survival mechanics and educational objectives into an interactive gaming experience. We considered gameplay simplicity, lunar environment design, performance limitations and accessibility to ensure the game could run on modest hardware.

Our intended impact is to inspire young people to explore astronomy, space science and future lunar missions through interactive learning.
